use_cases: Landing page hero section with animated grid background effect
Dark-themed website ambient visual with flickering grid animation
SaaS product hero with tech-inspired grid backdrop
ai_summary: A canvas-based flickering grid hero component that renders an animated grid of squares with randomized opacity flickering. Uses intersection observer for scroll-triggered animation, only rendering when visible. Fully customizable with props for grid size, gap, flicker probability, color, and maximum opacity. Creates a modern tech-inspired ambient effect ideal for dark-themed hero sections.
